vocab.example: The biggest lesson learned this sprint is to test the API earlier.
vocab.example_vi: Bài học lớn nhất sprint này là phải kiểm thử API sớm hơn.

vocab.example: Let's experiment with shorter standups for two weeks.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy thử nghiệm họp standup ngắn hơn trong hai tuần.

vocab.example: Our build time is now twenty minutes, which is too long.
vocab.example_vi: Thời gian build của chúng ta giờ là hai mươi phút, quá lâu.

vocab.meaning_vi: nhận trách nhiệm, chủ động phụ trách
vocab.example: Minh will take ownership of improving the build pipeline.
vocab.example_vi: Minh sẽ nhận trách nhiệm cải thiện pipeline build.

vocab.example: We should keep doing code reviews in pairs because they work well.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta nên tiếp tục review code theo cặp vì nó hiệu quả.

vocab.example: Hoa was overloaded with testing at the end of the sprint.
vocab.example_vi: Hoa bị quá tải việc kiểm thử vào cuối sprint.

vocab.meaning_vi: công cụ hỗ trợ phát triển
vocab.example: Better tooling could save each developer an hour a day.
vocab.example_vi: Công cụ tốt hơn có thể giúp mỗi lập trình viên tiết kiệm một giờ mỗi ngày.

vocab.meaning_vi: đánh giá thấp, ước lượng thiếu
vocab.example: We underestimated the work for the payment feature.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta đã ước lượng thiếu khối lượng việc cho tính năng thanh toán.

lines.speaker: Linh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Okay everyone, let's start the retro. First, what should we keep doing from sprint eighteen?

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Dev)
lines.text: Pair code reviews. They helped us release the payment feature on time.

lines.speaker: Linh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Agreed. Anything that didn't go so well?

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: I was overloaded at the end. Most tickets reached testing on the last two days.

lines.speaker: Minh (Frontend Dev)
lines.text: That's partly because of our build time. It took twenty minutes each time.

lines.speaker: Linh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: So the tooling slowed everyone down. Did we also underestimate the work?

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Dev)
lines.text: Yes. The payment feature was bigger than we thought, so two tickets moved to the next sprint.

lines.speaker: Hoa (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Maybe we can experiment with caching in the build pipeline?

lines.speaker: Minh (Frontend Dev)
lines.text: Good idea. I'll take ownership of that and try it next sprint.

lines.speaker: Linh (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Great. So the lesson learned is to fix tooling problems early. Let's check the result next retro.

questions.q: What should the team keep doing?

options: Most tickets reached testing at the end

questions.q: Who will take ownership of the caching experiment?

shadowing: I want to give a quick shout-out to Hoa for her great help.
The slow build time was the biggest pain point for me this sprint.
We had to carry over two tickets because the API was not ready.
Can we experiment with a shorter standup for the next two weeks?
Let's choose one owner for each action so nothing gets forgotten.
